scope: T4 closed as T4.2-lite (user decision 2026-09-14): single-site semantic dedup with constructor-faithful families; T4.1/T4.3/T4.4 closed as no-significant-gain

baseline_shift.finding: The T4.6 acceptance anchor (isl-cold-lazy: explore_schedules 20.6s + 4 payloads ~18.6s + streams 7.3s, total 48s) was already captured by T1's structural fixes before T4 started.
profile_facts: legal() is cheap (0.03-0.07s per candidate) and not the payload cost driver
the expensive payloads are the window/tile candidates (1.0s, 2.3s) - exactly the non-stage-major schedules the T4.4 serial (a,m) envelope summary cannot accelerate
merge dedup costs ~7ms per pair on the 20-statement program; S^2 no longer binds after T1 statement reduction
T4.3's compute_schedule target is only 0.35s; T4.4's reachable slice is ~1s for days of stage-decomposition work

t4_2_lite_changes.window_family: deleted per-build dual equivalent_order checks (vs reference and vs base); window/tile families enumerate constructor-faithfully
t4_2_lite_changes.merge_single_site: semantic dedup lives only in the shared catalog merge: text pre-filter (seen set) then exact equivalent_order against accepted schedules; a family turn pulls until one distinct candidate arrives so duplicates never consume round-robin turns
t4_2_lite_changes.boundedness: no artificial comparison budget needed: every family is emission-capped, so total comparisons are structurally bounded (<= ~3*max_candidates^2)
t4_2_lite_changes.rejected_tile_identity_rule: constructor-specific tile-identity rule (size >= extent on all but one axis => base order) considered and rejected: it never fires on the real config (layer-segment extent 21 > tile sizes 2-16, token extents parametric) and would only serve small test configs
test_updates: test_region_windows.py: consumes the genuinely windowed candidate via the shared catalog (production path) instead of the family's first emission
test_region_tiling.py lazy-merge oracle: expected builder mirrors pull-until-distinct turn semantics; zip_longest round-robin dropped

acceptance.catalog_byte_identical: real-size config (2x24 layers, 64 positions, hidden 896 bf16): 8 candidates byte-identical schedule maps before/after; stream signatures identical
acceptance.wall_clock: 7.74s -> 7.70s (nil, as profiled; the win is structural: one dedup site, no per-build full-domain order comparisons in families)
acceptance.pytest_full_cpu: 612 passed, 2 failed (test_inplace_region dtype1-cuda numerical, pre-existing since pre-T1 baseline eb75810)

closure_rationale: User decision 2026-09-14: close T4 after T4.2-lite. T4.3/T4.4 invoked the plan's own no-merge-if-no-gain clause; remaining cold-compile time (~7.7s per catalog) is a small fraction of the full cold start. Next: profile the full make_llm cold start to find the real remaining hot spot.
